judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote a `.lore/dod.md` planning file, a single failing acceptance test (`src/transport/ws/messageHandler.acceptance.test.ts`), and a one-line spec addition, without implementing any production code. None of the required changes to `src/types/messages.ts`, `validation.ts`, `messageHandler.ts`, `createServer.ts`, `config.ts`, `ErrorCodes`, `CHANGELOG.md`, or `docs/getting-started.md` were made. Furthermore, the newly added test fails to compile and fails at runtime because `conversation_list` does not exist on `OutgoingMessage` and `createMessageHandler` does not handle `list_conversations`.
